text:
QUOTE: "Archive a channel | `app/actions/remote/channel.ts:1397-1401` | Sets `delete_at` locally and keeps the user as a member | Removes the current user from the channel locally" and "If the archived channel is current, emits `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED` and kicks the user out; then removes the user from the channel"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when viewing is disabled the user is removed from the channel and kicked out if it is current, and that when viewable the channel gets `delete_at` set and is kept.
